scope: Opposed tension-only bands with equilibrated neutral preload, plus complementary TPU stiffness. Fixed support candidates are relative to scapula but no bracket is designed. Straight tension bands are screened as 0.7 mm-radius cylinders only when taut. Terminal strap attachment, fatigue, wire curvature and integrated dynamics are pending.
